why: The text says 'our driver pulled up' and the party is in a landau (¶51, ¶69).

text: The long grey-tiled out-building across the paddock
why: ¶69 says 'Some distance off, across a paddock, lay a long grey-tiled out-building.' The label repeats this without adding an identity.
¶69 says the moor's sky-line is 'broken only by the steeples of Tavistock'.
Same issue as label 2: the story has not yet said that this red-brick villa is Straker's.

text: Thursday evening, the landau pulls up at a red-brick villa
why: ¶13 establishes that this is Thursday, ¶47 says they reached Tavistock in the evening, and ¶69 has the landau pulling up at the villa.
